mastery_task.scenario_en: It is your first day in an online study group.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: هذا أول يوم لك في مجموعة دراسة عبر الإنترنت.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Introduce yourself in four or five short sentences.
mastery_task.support: Field icons or labels only; no sentence frames or model.
mastery_task.freshness: The scenario and field order differ from guided practice.
mastery_task.prior_lesson_support: U1-L01 greetings and U1-L02 listening input may be recalled, but no complete introduction is shown.

rubric.level_2: Includes the four requested detail categories.
A listener can identify the learner and essential details.
Adapts the introduction to the new study-group situation.
Essential details stay intelligible and one breakdown can be repaired.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; give targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening every section or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح باختصار الفرق بين I'm from و I live in، ثم أعط مثالًا واحدًا.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: New identity card; give a four-detail spoken introduction.
Correct an origin/residence mix-up, then introduce yourself.
New first-meeting context with a different final detail.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: You have just joined a local community event.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: انضممت الآن إلى فعالية محلية وتقابل شخصًا للمرة الأولى.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Introduce yourself in four or five short sentences.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Field icons or labels only; no sentence frames or model.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: The setting, listener, and field order differ from both practice and the primary task.
replacement_mastery_task.use_only_when: The primary attempt became practice after answer-revealing correction or help.
